images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: first illustrated prologue slide for the game Stellar Syndicates.
Input image 1: edit target — the current wormhole-opening illustration.
Primary request: correct the spatial relationship. The wormhole gate currently appears to intersect Earth's surface. Move the entire gate MUCH farther out into open space, so there is an unmistakable broad band of dark starfield between the lowest part of its structure and the planet's atmospheric limb. The complete gate, including ALL protruding supports, must be visibly outside and separate from the planet, with no overlap or tangency at all.
Composition/framing: retain a wide 16:9 landscape frame (same 1672 x 941 composition). Reframe as a pulled-back establishing view: the planet recedes into the lower-left corner and occupies only the bottom-left portion, while the gate sits in the upper-right open space. Reduce the gate's apparent size enough to show its complete outer ring and supports comfortably inside the frame. Keep a substantial visible gap of empty space, at least about ten percent of the image height, between the nearest gate structure and Earth's atmospheric edge. This must clearly read as a free-floating deep-space installation, not a structure erected on or emerging from the planet. Expedition ships travel away from Earth toward the distant gate.
Preserve: the same distinctive engineered dark-metal ring design, luminous blue-white aperture showing a spiral galaxy, practical white-and-graphite human expedition ships with blue exhaust, cinematic realistic concept-painting style, warm sunrise at Earth's limb, cool portal lighting and hopeful mood. Keep the original subjects and narrative; do not add new objects or redesign the ships.
Avoid: ring touching the planet or atmosphere, ring occluded by the planet, supports reaching the planet, any gate section cropped out of frame, extra planets, extra objects, labels, captions, borders, logos or watermark. No text.
images.selection: Exact user attachment copied unchanged. Decoded pixels verified identical to wormhole-opening-v2; no new generation or visual edits.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one cinematic illustration for the opening slideshow of Stellar Syndicates, a persistent science-fiction colony and trading game.
Style/medium: high-end realistic digital science-fiction concept painting, grounded industrial spacecraft and believable materials, refined atmosphere and restrained detail, hopeful frontier mood. Cohesive visual language: charcoal metal, cool blue-white technology, subtle amber practical lights, natural planet greens and blues. Not a poster or a user interface.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9 illustration. Strong readable focal point, essential subjects kept within the central 75% of the frame; comfortable edges for responsive display. Full image, not a collage. The game adds all captions and controls below the image.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, logos, title, watermark, borders, captions or fake interface. No battle, no explosions, no alien characters.
Primary request: a stellar charter grants the player's corporation the right to settle a new planet in the newly accessible galaxy.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet civilian charter office aboard a space station, with a broad observation window overlooking a green-blue habitable world and a few distant colony vessels.
Subject: in the foreground, a charter official presents a refined dark metallic document tablet to a civilian expedition leader. The tablet displays only a luminous blue holographic planet and a small geometric authorization seal, with NO writing. Show the exchange clearly as the granting of a new-world settlement charter; human figures are understated, seen in three-quarter view, practical civilian expedition clothes rather than armor. The tablet and world beyond are the main focus.
Composition/framing: medium-wide cinematic scene, natural hands and proportions, intimate but spacious, no close-up portrait; legible ceremonial handover at small display sizes.
Lighting/mood: dignified, hopeful responsibility; cool planetary light from the window and soft warm interior light. No monarch, empire insignia, weapons or grand palace.
